name: Cisco

Software Engineer II.dsaDepth: Moderate - 3 technical rounds plus managerial and HR, leaning on core CS fundamentals (C, networking, OS) alongside DSA
rounds: 3 technical rounds: coding (linked list and other DSA), networking fundamentals, OS concepts, past-experience discussion
extraTopics: Networking fundamentals - expected given Cisco’s core business
C-language proficiency and OS concepts alongside DSA
Software Engineer II.notes: One Bengaluru report describes this full loop completed in a single day (~5 hours) with a 95% reported pass rate for that cohort.

Software Engineer IV (senior).dsaDepth: Moderate - an HR screen, then a multi-stage onsite panel including engineering leadership
rounds: Panel interviews with Director of Engineering, Hiring Manager, Senior Engineer, VP of Operations, and HR Manager (2+ engineers per round)
Earlier stages: a phone screen with basic C coding/OS questions, then a C-programming phone interview
extraTopics: C programming and OS/computer-architecture/assembly fundamentals across up to 6 video interviews
Engaging with senior leadership (VP-level) as part of the standard loop, not just an exception
